lines: Phase 3 (the look lock) is 2 hours into its 11 hour box. Ten builders are 45 minutes into their parts and none of these pictures is finished work
The layout measured on the approved winter image is in main: the ground is a mound raked toward the viewer and the cottage and the tree stand where the image has them (decision 43)
The film's close camera and the interior camera are fitted to that layout again and all 305 tests are green
Decision 44: the key light comes from the upper right in front as the approved image shows. The kit says upper left

Decision 45: the shake's lift and tilt go below the range the kit gives the Builder so the lifted glass keeps about 5 percent of the frame above it and the foot's rim never enters the surface. Listed for your review
The published app is unchanged since 08:34 UTC (the Phase 2 stand-in globe). It is published again when the builders' parts are merged
First reports from the builders are due at about 11:30 UTC
phase 3: 2.28 h used of its 11.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 8.89 h used of 36.00 h allowed

pictures.caption: Glass builder: the approved image above and the rebuilt glass shell below on the stand-in miniature. A starting point. Still wrong: grey wash through the liquid and an even grey rim and a blown highlight

Light builder: the approved image above and the first pass of the light engine below on the stand-in miniature. Still wrong: the key is too strong and the warm pools by the lamp and the window do not read

Tree builder: the real trunk from the film's close camera with bark from one generated sheet. Still wrong: no crown and no snow on the roots and the bark is too orange. The cottage and lamp beside it are stand-ins

Three cameras framed again on the stand-in globe, draft: surface (the foot of the base above, the surface and the globe's reflection under it), interior (the miniature fills the height), low (looking up at the whole globe from 24 mm above the surface) (by engine_engineer_2)
